messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — freeze begins in 30 minutes (21:00 PT). Doing a last-minute checklist and rollback readiness sweep. Call out any blockers or required unpins.

Sophia: On it. Running final end-to-end smoke on staging (auth, inference, embeds). ETA ~8m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary created: canary-2026-03-21-30 (service: inference, version: v3.14.2). Pin applied to canary lane. To manually revert: `/deploy rollback --to v3.14.1 --reason "emergency"`.

Maria: Canary telemetry ok so far. 1m error rate 0.11% (baseline 0.10%), P95 +6ms. Watching for cache warmups.

Ron: Oncall monitoring. Ive set a temporary alert for >2x error rate or P95 jump >80ms. I'll escalate if triggered. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/launch-freeze

Tim: Release notes live in Console. No DB migrations bundled, correct? @Dave

Dave: Confirmed no schema changes. Only a runtime config flip in config-service. Ill be ready to toggle back if needed and will post timestamps on action.

Sophia: Smoke update: auth flows pass, embeddings warm after a couple requests, no obvious token leaks. Load test small spike resolved.

Alex: Rollback triggers (if any of these happen, call for rollback):\n- sustained error rate >= 3x baseline for 5 minutes
- P95 latency > baseline +100ms across 3 consecutive 1-min windows
- embed quality drop >5% on canary eval
If you see this, post `rollback` in channel and @sre-oncall will initiate.

Maria: Note: transient cache warmup can cause a tiny bump. If we see a short blip <2m, call it out; don't auto-rollback yet.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Automated rollback is available. `/deploy rollback --auto` will perform stop-canary, repin previous stable, drain, and run quick smoke checks. All steps are posted here as they execute.

sre-oncall: I'm primary for monitoring the next 60m. I'll coordinate with SRE lead on any escalations. Pager and phone on.

Alex: Lock repo: no merges to main during freeze. Feature toggle fallback is prepared if we need a graceful degrade. :lock:

Tim: Small docs PR was pushed to a branch; do NOT merge until freeze lifts.

Maria: Emergency unpin API (if CLI is unavailable): `curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/api/v1/pin -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"service":"inference","version":"v3.14.1"}'` (ops token required).

Dave: Standing by to flip config toggle and confirm timings in thread.

Alex: Please acknowledge with one-word ack for audit.

Sophia: ack
Maria: ack
Ron: ack
Dave: ack
Tim: ack
sre-oncall: ack

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Status update: canary-2026-03-21-30 healthy after 6m. Metric deltas within expected margins. Will post next update in 5m. :white_check_mark:

Alex: Thanks team. Keep channel quiet unless escalation or rollback. Pinning runbook to this thread for quick reference. :thumbsup:
